benchmark: BANKING77 full-77-way (mteb/banking77 test split) — all 77 intents, 500 gold items (~6-7/class, Unsloth's cut size), multi-token loglikelihood option scoring

method.readout: zero-training L0 readout: per-option sum log-softmax continuations off one prompt-cache copy per rotation (score_suffix_sum), softmax over the 77 sums, batch prior (0.75, position space, min_n=8) + cyclic-shift marginalization (logmean) — same building blocks as the served pipeline; nothing fit on banking77
method.greedy: temp-0 decode, same prompt (identity listing order), answers parsed longest-first containment vs the 77 labels

context: published full-77-way macro-F1 (Cloudflare Clef table): Clef 94.2 / Clef-flash 90.9 / Jev 79.7; Unsloth trained 0.8B 74% / 2B 58% accuracy — TRAINED, in-distribution (banking77 is in their training mix); ours is zero-training frozen 4-bit
